Ruling: batch #432 item 2 · letter E · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-31T02:42Z

Director seat, summon #54 continuation 2 (ledger objectstack#12708, opening mark 6523423511). The maintainer asked 「整个拆分过程是不是动作太小了，有没有大切块的方案」 on #25467's cut-36 presentation; this card carried the big-chunk plan; the maintainer answered, verbatim: 「同意」 — letter **E**.

**What the ruling binds (letter E — the section-level plan replaces the per-member series):**
- **E0** the 6,374-line preamble of `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` (177 top-level declarations, 85 exported, 3,938 comment-ish lines) moves wholesale into themed modules — no host object needed — in one PR; the by-path pins and the census learn the new module paths in the same PR if they read any preamble symbol.
- **E1** one **closed, named rewrite set** is allowed inside moved bodies, checked by tool with a negative control: `this.<member>` → `host.<member>`; a private static `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.<fn>(…)` → `host.<fn>(…)` with the static exposed on the host; `this.constructor` → the host. Nothing else changes in a moved body (AST identity modulo exactly that set). The two by-path pins (`protocol.read-verb-canonical-fold.test.ts`, `protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`) and the read-seam census resolve through the host split for every module, once, as #28058 did for the census — each with a negative control that a body that skips the checked property still fails.
- **E2** five section cuts by #25467's own table (metadata reads · query validation · data CRUD · batch and `*Many` · discovery and diagnostics, then the class head), one PR per section (1,000–3,000 lines), each on a **declared `protocol.ts` freeze day** posted on the server seat post; other PRs touching the file queue behind it for that day. Member declarations stay on the class as stubs, so the `.d.ts` bar (ruling 6348891160: identity after sorting union members, same export list) holds; `tsc`, the full package suite, the census and the pins are green on every PR.
- #25467 stays the execution card; its cut-36 question (A / S / D) is answered by E: the six read-verb members and the three that already pass move inside E2's reads section, not as a separate cut 36. Not taken: A (the per-member series to the same end state in ~6–7 weeks and ~100 PRs).

Governing text: #24586 ruling A (6270097840); #23050 shape B (the host pattern); ruling 6348891160 (`.d.ts` bar); cut 34 ruling B (6520565826) and #25467's 6523456539 — the per-member levers E1 resolves once. Premises re-read at `origin/main` `121d1a5f` (this card's body).

**Workload of the letter:** `domain:server` · about 8 PRs (E0 one · E1 one · E2 five or six) · each L · the same card thread under the server seat's landing grant · `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` (no published surface change; `packages/spec` untouched). The dev re-measures each section against today's file before its PR; the freeze day is the lane's hot-file queue, not a new gate.

**Execution:** this card closes `completed` in this act, its plan recorded on #25467 (ruling pointer there); #25467 `needs-user-decision` → `pm:dispatched` (assignee `os-elon-musk`, the seat's claim stands); the server lane's card thread runs E0 → E1 → E2 with `Ruling-ref:` naming this comment.

os-decision-facets
① 长远：同一终态，约 8 个 PR 两周 vs 上百个 PR 两个月；改写集封闭、机械可核
② 拉动：`protocol.ts` 在热文件串行队列，每个 server PR 都在付
③ 防错：改写集逐条点名、带反向对照、AST 工具逐 token 核；冻结日防脏 diff；`.d.ts` 门槛不动
④ 不扩散：不加门禁不加协议面；pin 与普查一次性解析扩展
